reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering root crops, fish, cauliflower, cave forage and jelly, caviar, a mineral, specialized bait, mushrooms, and cheese dishes were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover crop timing, fish habitat, fishing-bar mechanics, biological and culinary wording, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Carrot_Description.source: A fast-growing, colorful tuber that makes for a great snack.
Carrot_Description.translation: Un tubercul colorat, cu creștere rapidă, numai bun de ronțăit.

CarrotSeeds_Description.source: Plant in the spring. Takes 3 days to grow.

Catfish_Description.source: An uncommon fish found in streams.
Catfish_Description.translation: Un pește mai puțin întâlnit, care trăiește în pâraie.

Cauliflower_Description.source: Valuable, but slow-growing. Despite its pale color, the florets are packed with nutrients.
Cauliflower_Description.translation: Valoroasă, dar crește încet. În ciuda culorii palide, buchețelele sunt pline de nutrienți.

CauliflowerSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 12 days to produce a large cauliflower.
CauliflowerSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Au nevoie de 12 zile pentru a produce o conopidă mare.

CaveCarrot_Description.source: A starchy snack found in caves. It helps miners work longer.
CaveCarrot_Description.translation: O gustare bogată în amidon, găsită în peșteri. Îi ajută pe mineri să lucreze mai mult timp.

CaveJelly_Description.source: A rare jelly found in underground lakes.
CaveJelly_Description.translation: Un jeleu rar, găsit în lacurile subterane.

Caviar_Name.preservationReason: Caviar is the established Romanian culinary term and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Caviar_Description.source: The cured roe of a sturgeon fish. Considered to be a luxurious delicacy!
Caviar_Description.translation: Icre maturate de sturion. Este considerat o delicatesă de lux!

Celestine_Description.source: Some early life forms had bones made from this.
Celestine_Description.translation: Unele forme de viață timpurii aveau oase alcătuite din acest mineral.

ChallengeBait_Description.source: A "perfect" catch yields triple the fish. However, each time a fish escapes the "fishing bar", the catch is reduced.
ChallengeBait_Description.translation: O captură „perfectă” oferă de trei ori mai mulți pești. Totuși, de fiecare dată când un pește scapă din „bara de pescuit”, captura scade.

Chanterelle_Description.source: A tasty mushroom with a fruity smell and slightly peppery flavor.
Chanterelle_Description.translation: O ciupercă gustoasă, cu miros fructat și gust ușor piperat.
